note: M213: the specification of the decoder in tools/scd_vm.py, small enough to check by eye. Each case is a hand-built byte record in hex, the pc to start at, optionally the block's u16[] record table (which is what resolves 0x18 and 0x03), and the trace the decoder must produce: one record per step, in order, with {pc, opcode, name, advance, successors, state}. A case that must be refused carries raises instead of trace: truncated (a command that runs off the end of the record), unknown (not a table slot) or unresolved (no advance at all). Nothing here is timing, random or machine-dependent.

cases.name: fall-through: three Nops; the third advances to the record's end

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0x3

cases.name: conditional branch, fall-through arm: 0x0d ForStart at 0 skips to 0+2+6 = 8

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0xa

cases.name: conditional branch, taken arm: the same record decoded from its skip target 8

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0xa

cases.name: computed jump: 0x17 Goto at 0 takes cmd+s16[4] = 6 and has no fall-through

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0x7

cases.name: GoSub then return: 0x18 saves cmd+2 and calls record 1 at 0x0a, 0x19 pops it back

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0xc

cases.name: block push and pop: 0x06 saves its continuation 4, 0x10 resumes it - the loop is reported

expect.stop: revisit: 0x4 was already decoded in this record

cases.name: yield: 0x01 with no GoSub slot open returns 2 to the dispatcher (FUN_8009b880.c:26)

expect.stop: yield: walk_stream.py's DYNAMIC record: 0x01 returns 2 to the dispatcher (FUN_8009b880.c:26) with no GoSub slot open

cases.name: 0x36 advances 12: its dispatch is over a static five-entry table and every arm shares one tail

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0xc

cases.name: 0x36 in a record shorter than its own 12 bytes is truncated, not followed
a block pop with an empty stack is blocked, not advanced by a guess

expect.stop: blocked: 0x10 pops a block slot and no opener pushed one

cases.name: a GoSub with no record table is blocked: the destination is a table this trace lacks

expect.stop: blocked: 0x18 needs the block's record table

cases.name: 0x03 without a record table is blocked

expect.stop: blocked: 0x03 reads u16[1] from the block's record table, which this trace lacks

cases.name: 0x03 with the block's record table jumps to u16[1] = 6

expect.stop: terminated: the record's stream ends at 0x8

cases.name: a truncated command: 0x44 is 22 bytes, five are left, so the read is refused
an unknown opcode byte: 0x8d is not a slot of the 141-entry table
the step cap: a record cut short says so instead of looking complete
